definition: Manuscript estimate: mean of per-network 80%-richness thresholds, rounded to nearest 10 percentage points
note: This is the calculation supporting the rounded 40% statement.
The median network requires 40% of its flowering plants.

definition: Strict alternative: first 5%-grid proportion where the across-network mean richness captured is >= 80%
note: At 40%, the across-network mean captured richness is 77.82%; this stricter curve reaches 80% at 45%.
